businessProblem: An owner feels the business is 'in trouble' but has not yet provided concrete figures; they want a diagnosis now.

evidence.finding: Owner reports a vague sense of cash pressure but cannot supply runway, burn, or balance figures yet
No management accounts or bank statements have been shared; all figures are anecdotal and unverified
Operational metrics were described only qualitatively with no numbers attached at this time
Owner cannot say whether customer counts are rising or falling this period
